A nominal designation written as a number and not a measured magnification. The measured quantity of this pair is pixel_size_20x_zoom_1x, 0.32373 um at E2 and 1x1 binning, and that is where any sampling calculation starts -- never the figure in a frame's metadata, which comes from whichever configuration file was loaded.

assumptions.statement: The optical chain is the person's declaration: the 20x dry objective at 1x, the Aura III's green line for excitation, the 605 path on the red camera, and a widefield light path, all set by the person's hand. None of it is derived by any axis. It is declared because the thing this question measures -- the photon rate per particle and its decay -- depends on the whole chain together, which is why tracer_brightness is absent from the store and cannot be asked for. A declaration is not evidence, whoever makes it, so it stays E5.
assumptions.falsifier: the stand's own read-back at preflight: getStateLabel on the nosepiece and on the intermediate magnification. A nosepiece label that is not the 20x, or a zoom that is not 1x, retires the declaration and the plan refuses. Today's preparatory run records exactly that read-back, so it is also the first test of it.

constraint_notes: WHAT THIS QUESTION IS. The formal measurement of tracer_brightness, with bleaching_rate beside it, for particle_suspension_a through the 20x dry objective. Its plan will stand on today's preparatory run (card 033) as the input that bounds exposure and intensity -- the run a plan may exist without, as settled in plan.md at 32e2263. It is NOT a way to file today's frames as a result: its plan governs a run that has not happened yet, and a plan whose run is today's run would say a plan preceded a run it did not.

WHY A NEW QUESTION AND NOT A REVISION OF mic-20260920-001. That question is the 100x oil objective with software motion, and its axis ranges were computed for that configuration. Citing them for the 20x would be carrying numbers across a configuration they were never computed for.

NO SOFTWARE MOTION IN THE PLAN. The objective turret, focus, stage, filters and light path are set by the person's hand. The retract-before-rotation and clearance interlocks still block the first software-driven motion (card 023), and nothing in this question lifts that. Software drives only the excitation and the camera, by their MM labels `Aura` and `Kinetix_red`.

THE SAMPLE. particle_suspension_a, the bottle in use, cited from the store: 5 um diameter with a CV no greater than 0.02, measured on the bottle (tracer_diameter_measured, E2). Its identification as Abvigen AFR-0500-COOH is E5 (particle_suspension_a_identity), so any type-level fact about that product reaching this bench is E5. Bare particles on a coverslip are not the mount mic-20260918-001 protects, so this measurement spends nothing that question needs.

WHICH LINE. The only excitation evidence about this bottle is particles_show_on_the_green_605_path (E2): they fluoresce under Aura green and show through the 605 band. That is BAND COMPATIBILITY and not a spectral peak, and its 555 and 605 are nominal band centres of the instrument, not properties of the particle. So the line is the Aura's GREEN, picked by the name the device reports, and the record is taken through the 605 path. The store's product-type excitation figure was fetched under this caller_id and is deliberately NOT carried: the same bench observation refutes it. If an axis needs an excitation wavelength as a number, that is a named gap, not that figure.

THE EXCITATION IS WHERE THE VOCABULARY RUNS OUT. The person declared the Aura III. The capability table names widefield_source_a and widefield_source_b, and which of them the Aura is -- the Lapp branch assignment -- is not established (lapp_branch_assignment_absent). The store answers to no name widefield_source_a at all (widefield_source_a_absent), and the device registry carries no Micro-Manager labels. So the Aura is carried here by its MM label, and this card does not map it to a channel id. That mapping is a card after today, and today's run may settle it. Until it lands, the configuration label S3.0 screens against is not confirmed to be the path that physically runs.

THE RED ARM, AND ONE LINK IN IT IS E5. The 605 path is taken on `Kinetix_red` (camera_red_mm_control_path, E3). The link from the emission wheel to the red camera is emission_wheel_camera_mapping, an operator recall at E5 carrying the word probably. mic-20260920-001 recorded the person confirming the red arm on 2026-09-21 as a decision; this card cites that decision and does not promote the entry.

THE MASTER STATE, AND THE PER-MILLE SCALE. With the Aura's master `State` at 0 no light leaves the engine however the line and its intensity are set, and both read back as written (light_engine_master_state_gates_every_line, E3). A brightness and a bleaching measurement are the two quantities that still return a number when the light is off, so the plan must carry `State` as a condition the operator verifies, not trusts. Line intensity is per mille, 0 to 1000 (light_engine_line_intensity_is_per_mille, E3): a person's 10 per cent is 100.

WHAT IS ASKED FOR AND IS NOT THERE. Six gaps, all service-answered at kbv-4b981dc870d3 with the librarian reachable. tracer_brightness and bleaching_rate are the point of the question and close by acquiring, first by today's preparatory run. light_engine_output_power is the missing dial-to-milliwatt calibration, so an intensity stays a commanded per-mille integer and not a power. light_engine_channel_sets and lapp_branch_assignment are which lines the Aura carries and which branch it is on. widefield_source_a is the channel id the capability table uses and the store does not know.

WHAT THIS CARD DOES NOT CARRY. No exposure, intensity or record length: those are what today's run bounds, and writing them now would be inventing the operating point the run exists to supply. No camera mode: the person named DynamicRange for the 100x question on 2026-09-20 and has not said so for this one, and A1's read noise stays four values until a mode is chosen. No turret, filter or light-path selector values beyond what the store holds.
